notes_text: Single-player old-school-style action-adventure/FPS emphasizing battles, treasure, weapon upgrades and exploration. Developer Perfect Random; Steam says early-access release was 28 October 2024 and exiting early access is scheduled for 28 October 2026, which remains tomorrow on the research date, 27 October 2026.

source_log.observation: Steam confirms 2024 early-access launch, original studio, action/adventure mechanics and scheduled 28 October 2026 1.0 exit.
